name: codepipeline
description: CodePipeline Overview This is the CodePipeline API Reference.

subcommands.name: acknowledge-job
subcommands.description: Returns information about a specified job and whether that job has been received by the job worker.

subcommands.name: acknowledge-third-party-job
subcommands.description: Confirms a job worker has received the specified job.

subcommands.name: create-custom-action-type
subcommands.description: Creates a new custom action that can be used in all pipelines associated with the Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: create-pipeline
subcommands.description: Creates a pipeline.

subcommands.name: delete-custom-action-type
subcommands.description: Marks a custom action as deleted.

subcommands.name: delete-pipeline
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified pipeline.

subcommands.name: delete-webhook
subcommands.description: Deletes a previously created webhook by name.

subcommands.name: deregister-webhook-with-third-party
subcommands.description: Removes the connection between the webhook that was created by CodePipeline and the external tool with events to be detected.

subcommands.name: disable-stage-transition
subcommands.description: Prevents artifacts in a pipeline from transitioning to the next stage in the pipeline.

subcommands.name: enable-stage-transition
subcommands.description: Enables artifacts in a pipeline to transition to a stage in a pipeline.

subcommands.name: get-action-type
subcommands.description: Returns information about an action type created for an external provider, where the action is to be used by customers of the external provider.

subcommands.name: get-job-details
subcommands.description: Returns information about a job.

subcommands.name: get-pipeline
subcommands.description: Returns the metadata, structure, stages, and actions of a pipeline.

subcommands.name: get-pipeline-execution
subcommands.description: Returns information about an execution of a pipeline, including details about artifacts, the pipeline execution ID, and the name, version, and status of the pipeline.

subcommands.name: get-pipeline-state
subcommands.description: Returns information about the state of a pipeline, including the stages and actions.

subcommands.name: get-third-party-job-details
subcommands.description: Requests the details of a job for a third party action.

subcommands.name: list-action-executions
subcommands.description: Lists the action executions that have occurred in a pipeline.

subcommands.name: list-action-types
subcommands.description: Gets a summary of all CodePipeline action types associated with your account.

subcommands.name: list-deploy-action-execution-targets
subcommands.description: Lists the targets for the deploy action.

subcommands.name: list-pipeline-executions
subcommands.description: Gets a summary of the most recent executions for a pipeline.

subcommands.name: list-pipelines
subcommands.description: Gets a summary of all of the pipelines associated with your account.

subcommands.name: list-rule-executions
subcommands.description: Lists the rule executions that have occurred in a pipeline configured for conditions with rules.

subcommands.name: list-rule-types
subcommands.description: Lists the rules for the condition.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Gets the set of key-value pairs (metadata) that are used to manage the resource.

subcommands.name: list-webhooks
subcommands.description: Gets a listing of all the webhooks in this Amazon Web Services Region for this account.

subcommands.name: override-stage-condition
subcommands.description: Used to override a stage condition.

subcommands.name: poll-for-jobs
subcommands.description: Returns information about any jobs for CodePipeline to act on.

subcommands.name: poll-for-third-party-jobs
subcommands.description: Determines whether there are any third party jobs for a job worker to act on.

subcommands.name: put-action-revision
subcommands.description: Provides information to CodePipeline about new revisions to a source.

subcommands.name: put-approval-result
subcommands.description: Provides the response to a manual approval request to CodePipeline.

subcommands.name: put-job-failure-result
subcommands.description: Represents the failure of a job as returned to the pipeline by a job worker.

subcommands.name: put-job-success-result
subcommands.description: Represents the success of a job as returned to the pipeline by a job worker.

subcommands.name: put-third-party-job-failure-result
subcommands.description: Represents the failure of a third party job as returned to the pipeline by a job worker.

subcommands.name: put-third-party-job-success-result
subcommands.description: Represents the success of a third party job as returned to the pipeline by a job worker.

subcommands.name: put-webhook
subcommands.description: Defines a webhook and returns a unique webhook URL generated by CodePipeline.

subcommands.name: register-webhook-with-third-party
subcommands.description: Configures a connection between the webhook that was created and the external tool with events to be detected.

subcommands.name: retry-stage-execution
subcommands.description: You can retry a stage that has failed without having to run a pipeline again from the beginning.

subcommands.name: rollback-stage
subcommands.description: Rolls back a stage execution.

subcommands.name: start-pipeline-execution
subcommands.description: Starts the specified pipeline.

subcommands.name: stop-pipeline-execution
subcommands.description: Stops the specified pipeline execution.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds to or modifies the tags of the given resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from an Amazon Web Services resource.

subcommands.name: update-action-type
subcommands.description: Updates an action type that was created with any supported integration model, where the action type is to be used by customers of the action type provider.

subcommands.name: update-pipeline
subcommands.description: Updates a specified pipeline with edits or changes to its structure.
